cards.name: incident_root
cards.what: An Incident's card, the root of its thread when a Correlator says its Incidents are conversations (ADR 0052 §6). Members link to their own Cases; no buttons, because every action acts on one signal.

cards.name: root_firing
cards.what: The first card. Posted once per generation with chat.postMessage; everything after it is an edit of this message.

cards.name: root_resolved
cards.what: The terminal card, produced by chat.update. It is the ONLY record left in the channel, because the update that made it was silent.

cards.name: root_silenced
cards.what: The silenced card — oto's nearest thing to "snoozed". Only the reconciler can produce this state, and the colour is the near-white #dddddd.

cards.name: root_update_acked
cards.what: The SAME root message after chat.update. This is ADR 0008's primary verb: colour, status and footer move; the ts does not.

cards.fallback: :eyes: Acknowledged: CheckoutErrorRateHigh on eu-west-1. Severity critical, team payments, acknowledged, firing since 17:56 UTC.
cards.name: thread_reply_acked
cards.what: A thread reply. Replies are the EXCEPTION (ADR 0008): one is posted only when a human needs to be told something the card cannot say by changing.

cards.fallback: :arrow_right: This case is now part of Incident #12; later updates about it are posted in that Incident's thread.
cards.name: thread_reply_incident_pointer
cards.what: The ONE reply posted into a member Case's own thread when its later updates start going to the Incident's thread. Nothing already posted moves.

cards.name: thread_reply_remedy_proposed
cards.what: A Remedy an Investigator proposed, as a reply in its Incident's thread (ADR 0054 §2, §3): the exact command first, then its target, the approvals it needs and the rule that set that, then the Investigator's description — and the only buttons in an Incident's thread, Approve (behind a confirmation) and Decline.
